requirements.subtitles: Supporting speech only; never the primary visual
requirements.safety: All ages; no adult content, cruelty, humiliation, impersonation or dangerous challenges

pilot.title: My fridge became my life coach
pilot.voice: Warm, expressive English voice; do not imitate any real person
pilot.presenter: Original clearly fictional adult cartoon presenter in casual clothes

scenes.speech: My fridge started talking. Its first sentence was: we need to discuss your midnight cheese.
scenes.visual: Open immediately on an animated fridge opening its door and a surprised presenter holding cheese. Cut to a moving close-up.

scenes.speech: I asked for a snack. It asked for my five-year plan. I said, probably still standing here, asking for a snack.
scenes.visual: Presenter reaches for a snack; fridge rolls out a comically long calendar. Presenter gestures toward the snack.

scenes.speech: Then it organized a meeting. The milk chaired it. The carrots took notes. The leftover pizza joined remotely from the freezer.
scenes.visual: Cut to a miniature animated meeting inside the fridge: milk carton at the head of the table, carrots writing, pizza waving on a screen.

scenes.speech: Their main concern? I open the door, stare at everything, close it, and return thirty seconds later expecting new food.
scenes.visual: Match cuts of the presenter repeatedly opening and closing the door; the same food reacts with increasingly puzzled faces.

scenes.speech: Honestly, fair. So I tried to impress them. I bought a salad. The pizza immediately requested a transfer to another kitchen.
scenes.visual: A salad arrives like a new employee. Pizza wheels a small suitcase toward the door; presenter reacts.

scenes.speech: By evening, the fridge had promoted itself to life coach. It suggested balance. I put a cookie in each hand. Perfect balance.
scenes.visual: Fridge opens a coaching session; presenter physically balances two cookies on outstretched hands, then smiles at camera.

scenes.speech: Then came the twist. The fridge was not judging me. It was lonely. Nobody ever asks an appliance how its day went.
scenes.visual: Camera pushes in on the fridge's softer expression. Presenter sets down the cookies and sits beside it.

scenes.speech: So I asked. It said, pretty cool. I laughed. It repeated the joke six times. Now I understand why the toaster moved out.
scenes.visual: Fridge and presenter laugh; cut to a toaster quietly leaving with a suitcase. Keep the joke friendly.

scenes.speech: Tomorrow, the microwave wants a podcast. Which appliance would be the funniest roommate?
scenes.visual: Microwave pulls a microphone into view; presenter turns toward it in surprise. End on this visual joke without a long end card.

pilot.caption: My fridge held a meeting about my snack habits. Which appliance would be the funniest roommate? AI-assisted fictional entertainment. #comedy #animation #funny
pilot.production_note: Timing is a target, not a verified runtime. Measure the exported file. Adjust natural speech pacing and substantive action to reach at least 61 seconds; do not pad with silence.

release_gate: Verify the provider is connected and inspect its capabilities, available free quota and costs before generation. Do not purchase credits or subscriptions.
Export an actual moving video; reject a presenter pasted over static full-screen text cards.
Probe actual duration >=61 seconds, vertical video dimensions, playable video and audio streams.
Listen to the narration and inspect the beginning, middle, ending and every scene transition; ensure no truncated speech or excessive silence.
Check that visual actions illustrate the spoken jokes and subtitles are readable and secondary.
Verify required native AI disclosure is supported before publishing a realistic synthetic presenter. Caption disclosure alone must not be assumed sufficient.
Upload the local absolute MP4 path to Metricool with info.media=[]; retain slot and UUID when replacing a draft.
Reread the queue to confirm correct media, draft=false and autoPublish=true. Pending does not mean published.
